name: Filled Tainted Ooze Jar
summary: In Felwood, tainted ooze is gathered from the remains of corrupted oozes. The samples travel in containment jars to Ironforge, where they support bold theories about life’s origins on Azeroth.

sections.title: Slime of the Corrupted Wood
sections.body: Across northern Kalimdor, tainted oozes carry Felwood’s lingering corruption. Gnomish researchers provide jars to contain them safely. Most travelers keep clear of the noxious creatures, but their remains yield samples for natural philosophy and biological study far from the blighted woods.

sections.title: Geardawdle's Grand Theory
sections.body: Laris Geardawdle, a gnome scholar with the Explorers' League in Ironforge, gathers the samples. He is fascinated by how common slimes are, and has noticed the Forsaken's Royal Apothecary Society taking an interest in them as well. Many scholars dismiss his theory, but Geardawdle believes slimes and oozes may be primal secretions tied to Azeroth's creation. He seeks proof and a place among dwarven scholars after Gnomeregan's tragic fall.

faq.q: What is inside a Filled Tainted Ooze Jar?
faq.answer: A Filled Tainted Ooze Jar holds a fresh sample from the remains of a Tainted Ooze native to Felwood, sealed in a gnomish collection jar.
Laris Geardawdle, a gnome researcher working with the Explorers' League in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers, wants the samples for his natural history studies.

faq.q: Why is Laris Geardawdle studying oozes?
aliases: why does the gnome want ooze
faq.answer: Geardawdle saw the Royal Apothecary Society gathering slime samples and set out to understand their nature. He believes oozes are primordial secretions tied to Azeroth's creation, and hopes to earn a name for himself as a scientist in Ironforge.

aliases: where do i fill the jar
faq.answer: You gather the samples in Felwood by defeating Tainted Oozes and using an empty containment jar on their remains.

angles.text: As a gnome refugee in Ironforge, your scientific work with the Explorers' League can help prove your worth and repay dwarven hospitality after Gnomeregan's tragedy.
As an Alliance scout, you keep close watch on the Forsaken's Royal Apothecary Society. Learning why the Undercity gathers slime across the continents is a key intelligence priority.

attribution: A Little Slime Goes a Long Way
